t: This Blyss 16Ltr Dehumidifier efficiently extracts excess moisture from medium-sized rooms to prevent dampness and mould. Ideal for domestic use in damp bedrooms, kitchens, and utility rooms, this unit helps dry laundry quickly using its high-performance turbo setting. Trade professionals and homeowners can easily move the compact machine between spaces thanks to smooth-glide castor wheels. The unit features a generous 4Ltr water tank with an automatic shut-off safety function, a continuous drainage option for constant operation, and simple electronic controls with two speed settings for hassle-free humidity control.
b: Mould Prevention Enhances Indoor Air Quality
